newsitem.title: CANADA: Russel Metals closes deal with Samuel.
newsitem.headline: Russel Metals closes deal with Samuel.

text.p: Russel Metals Inc said on Friday it had closed its previously announced asset swap deal with Samuel, Son & Co.

It said that under an agreement signed today, Russel acquired the majority of Samuel's generalline hot rolled bar business in Canada while Samuel in turn bought the carbon steel light gauge flat rolled coil business of Russel in Ontario and Quebec.
The two companies also entered mutual supply agreements.
Russel, formerly Federal Industries Ltd, said the value of its assets in the deal totalled about C$35 million.
It said it is one of the five largest processors of metal and metal products in North America.
